text: Dr. Ja is incredibly kind and provides excellent advice and guidance on the most suitable treatment for each patient. I consulted with many places, but the most sincere and beneficial advice for patients was here. The treatment cost is reasonable, unlike other places that charged exorbitant prices. Dr. Ja was so dedicated to helping me regain my confidence and beauty. I thought I would never be able to speak confidently again because I had been told it was difficult at so many other places, but Dr. Ja did it like magic! I almost cried when I left the room, finally finding such a skilled doctor. Thank you again, Dr. Ja, for restoring my confidence.
